# `oira_reviews`

**OIRA EO 12866 reviews**

One row per Executive Order 12866 regulatory review conducted by OMB's Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA), ingested from reginfo.gov bulk XML exports via `spicy_docs.sources.oira` and `build_oira_reviews`. Covers both concluded reviews and rules currently pending at OIRA (`review_status = 'Under Review'`), filling the lifecycle stage between agency drafting and Federal Register publication. Keyed by `rin` (not unique: a rule may undergo multiple reviews across stages or resubmissions) for joining to `unified_agenda`, `federal_register`, and `oira_meetings`. Each downloaded XML original is retained once in the shared raw archive and referenced by `source_sha256`.

**Coverage.** True range. RegInfo.gov bulk XML exports of EO 12866 reviews from 1981 through the current year-to-date file plus rules currently under review; `source_file` names each XML export and `source_sha256` pins its retained bytes. Rebuilt in full on each run because reviews carry no publisher ID and reginfo.gov backfills `published_date` after review concludes. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `oira_reviews.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Regulation Identifier Number of the rule reviewed. Join key to `unified_agenda`, `federal_register`, and `oira_meetings`. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Acronym of the agency that owns the RIN, matching `unified_agenda.agency_code`. Falls back to the numeric 4-digit agency code when the agency is absent from `AGY_AGENCY_LIST.xml` (such as defunct historical agencies). |
| `agency_name` | `VARCHAR` | Full name of the agency that owns the RIN from reginfo.gov's agency list. Null when absent from the list. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Title of the rule as submitted to OIRA. |
| `stage` | `VARCHAR` | Rulemaking stage reviewed (e.g. `Proposed Rule`, `Final Rule`, `Interim Final Rule`, `Prerule`, `Notice`). Pre-2000 files use some historical labels. |
| `review_status` | `VARCHAR` | `Concluded` for a completed review or `Under Review` for one still pending at OIRA on the build date. |
| `received_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date OIRA received the rule for review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `concluded_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date OIRA concluded review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). Null while `Under Review`. |
| `review_days` | `BIGINT` | Calendar days from `received_date` to `concluded_date`. Null while `Under Review`. |
| `review_outcome` | `VARCHAR` | OIRA's literal decision string as published (e.g. `Consistent with Change`, `Consistent without Change`, `Withdrawn`, or historical pre-2000 phrasing such as `Consistent w/no change`). Null while `Under Review`. |
| `economically_significant` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes`/`No`: whether designated economically significant under EO 12866 section 3(f)(1). |
| `major` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes`/`No`: whether designated a major rule under the Congressional Review Act. Null when omitted or whitespace-only. |
| `legal_deadline` | `VARCHAR` | Whether the rule faced a deadline (`None`, `Statutory`, or `Judicial`). |
| `review_extended` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes` when OIRA extended its review period; rarely populated. |
| `published_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the rule appeared in the Federal Register after review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), when recorded by reginfo.gov. |
| `flags_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON object of additional review flag tags keyed by lower-cased XML tag name (e.g. `expedited_review`, `tcja`, `unfunded_mandates`, `federalism_implications`, `regulatory_flexibility_analysis`, `small_entities_affected`, `homeland_security`, `international_impacts`, `health_care_act`, `dodd_frank_act`, `pandemic_response`). Null when the source file carries none. |
| `source_file` | `VARCHAR` | RegInfo.gov XML export file name that supplied the row (e.g. `EO_RULE_COMPLETED_2025.xml`, `EO_RULE_COMPLETED_YTD.xml`, `EO_RULES_UNDER_REVIEW.xml`). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained RegInfo.gov XML export that supplied the row. |
